Stop typing "make it sound human." Paste this under your draft:

Rewrite so I could text it to a coworker.
- Max 15 words a sentence
- Use contractions
- Keep every fact I gave you
- Cut any sentence that says nothing

Tried it on: "Per my last email, I wanted to circle back regarding the status of the Q4 budget approval, as we are still awaiting your confirmation in order to proceed."

Got back: "Following up on the Q4 budget. We need your OK before we move. Can you confirm?"

threads.text:
There are thousands of AI tools. A normal workweek needs one chat window and four prompts:

1. Messy email: "Ask in line 1, max 5 sentences, keep my facts"
2. Chaotic to-do list: "Sort it into urgent / important / later / delete"
3. Task you keep avoiding: "Break it into 25-min steps, first one under 5 min"
4. Big plan: "Imagine it failed in 6 months. Top 10 reasons, then fixes for the top 3"

Full versions, free: https://makc9k.gumroad.com/l/starter10
